name: i-Tail Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: i-Tail Corporation Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, imports, and distributes pet food products in Thailand, Asia, Oceania, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates in two segments: Pet Food and Other Businesses. The company offers wet and dry food products for cats and dogs; dog and cat treats; kidney-friendly cat and dog foods; and wet cat food products made from meat and seafood, such as tuna, shrimp, or salmon. It sells its products under the Bellotta, Marvo, ChangeTer, Calico Bay, and Paramount brands.
